nodes.body: source: item 4-12.2 torque symbol(s): `T`, `M_Q` application domain: generic name: Torque quantity dimension: L^2*M^1*T^-2 measurement unit(s): N*m, kg*m^2*s^-2 tensor order: 0 definition: quantity described by the scalar product: `T = vec(M)*vec(e_Q)` where `vec(M)` is moment of force (item 4-12.1) and `vec(e_Q)` is unit vector of direction with respect to which the torque is considered remarks: For example, torque is the twisting moment of force with respect to the longitudinal axis of a beam or shaft.
